_header: Every field below marked with a matching entry in unverified_fields is a PLACEHOLDER,
not a fabricated real value. It was written from a checkout with no docker, no network
and no registry access, by the same data-safety constraint that forbade this task from
building, starting or connecting to any database. Fields use repeated single digits
(all-zero, all-one, all-two...) so a placeholder is visually unmistakable from a real
digest rather than merely regex-shaped like one — a syntactically valid but fabricated
hash is exactly the failure this lock file's own contract forbids. Resolving every field
in unverified_fields against an actual reachable registry/repository, then an actual
`docker build` and `docker inspect`/`SELECT version()` against the built image, is what
discharges each pin. Until then this lock validates its own shape and cross-file
agreement (see testing/tenant-info/deployment.ts) but proves nothing about the real
pg_textsearch_repo: UNVERIFIED — this task did not reach GitHub or any registry; resolve the exact upstream pg_textsearch v1.4.0 source repository URL before build
feature_report: artifacts/tenant-info-v4/extension-features.json — produced by `npm run tenant-info -- verify --suite deployment --profile integration --cases extension` on the actual built isolated image, NOT by this task and NOT present in this checkout
unverified_fields: postgres_version (17.999) — placeholder patch number; replace with the PG17 patch actually resolved and built, then rebuild base_image_tag/base_image_digest to match
base_image_digest — placeholder; replace with the real sha256 digest of the resolved postgres:<patch>-bookworm base image, read from the registry manifest, not guessed
architecture (linux/amd64) — an assumption about the build/deploy host, not measured from one; confirm against the actual build host's `docker version --format '{{.Server.Arch}}'` before accepting
pg_textsearch_repo — upstream source location for pg_textsearch v1.4.0 has not been resolved from this checkout
pg_textsearch_commit — placeholder; replace with the exact commit the v1.4.0 tag resolves to on the resolved upstream repository
pg_textsearch_source_sha256 — placeholder; replace with the SHA-256 of the actual downloaded source archive at that commit
built_image_digest — cannot exist before the image is built; fill in from `docker inspect` after `docker build` completes
text_configuration_fingerprint — cannot exist before the image is built and inspected; fill in after running the dependency case group's text-configuration/dictionary inspection
okf_reference_digest — cannot exist before the image is built and inspected; fill in after running the dependency case group
